text:
Rina: ok team, quick non-work thing: I prompted an LLM to write a 1-paragraph 'therapy note' from the office fern's perspective after it witnessed the 2pm meme war. it's peak. :herb:

Rina: ```Dear Caretakers, you watered me with coffee again and argued about tabs vs spaces within my potting soil. I wilt not from thirst but from the existential dread of unread PRs. Please, more sunlight and fewer passive-aggressive gifs. Yours, Fern.```

Omar: this is my favorite coworker substack now. can we get one for the ficus? :rofl:

Tess: make it a thread. next prompt: "Write a short, sassy fortune-cookie from the ficus about career choices."

ben: also lab test: feed the same prompt but set "style": "grandiose Shakespearean" and compare. I'll bring charts. :bar_chart:

bot-helper: @ben Running comparison job: styles - plain, sassy, shakespearean. Outputs posted to /tmp/plant-poetry.txt (jk).

Omar: honestly, the ficus would give better product strategy than my last two docs. maybe we should invite it to roadmap?! :seedling:

Rina: poll: who wants to anthropomorphize another appliance? React with :green_heart: for ficus, :sparkles: for microwave, :banana: for the mysterious office kettle (it judges us).

Tess: :green_heart: (ficus stan)

ben: :banana: kettle has opinions about overcaffeination

Omar: :sparkles: the microwave's a drama queen

Rina: ok ficus and kettle will duel in a poem-off next Friday 3pm. loser supplies cookies.

Tess: I will write the ficus's opening salvo. challenge accepted.

ben: can someone prompt the LLM to generate trophy engravings? "Most Dramatic Houseplant" is already taken.

Rina: adding to calendar: "Plant vs Appliance Poetry Duel". may the best sentient office object win. :trophy:
